messages:
anna-sales: FYI OmniHealth renewal is up on 2026-04-15. They reported ~20% uplift in usage and want the rate card rebaselined before renewal.
anna-sales: asking for guidance on commit size and discount floor — they’re asking for a 1.5x commit with a 25% net uplift concession.
mike-deals: tagging @raj-dealdesk — can we approve a temporary promotion for 1.5x commit? We probably need a conditioned SLA/throughput guarantee.
raj-dealdesk: need exact numbers. What’s current ARR, current committed GPU hours, and target commit? Also any special terms?
anna-sales: current ARR $420k, committed GPU hrs = 18k/mo; customer proposing 27k/mo (1.5x). They want 25% off list rate for first 6 months, then revert to 10% discount.
sarah-cs: OmniHealth is on Redwood Dedicated in us-west. They flagged a P0 query last quarter about tail latency; engineering shipped an optimization. They want us to include a latency SLA ramp for the uplift.
tom-eng: we can offer an SLO on p95 latency for their standard model tier but only if they commit to a max request QPS per pool and enable KV prefix caching. Will need annotation in the contract.
raj-dealdesk: discount math: 25% for 6 months then 10% thereafter — that's acceptable if sales guarantees the commit and we get a 12-month minimum. We should escalate if legal needs custom indemnities.
jess-legal: if we add SLA/throughput obligations we need to cap remedies to credits only. Also need to exclude third-party infra failures and allow for scheduled maintenance windows.
mike-deals: propose we do: 12-month term, 27k/mo commit, 25% off for first 6 months, 10% thereafter, SLA p95 with credit cap = 3% of monthly invoice per missed event, cumulative cap 12%. Anything else?
anna-sales: customer also asked for SOC2 + an updated security questionnaire answer for data residency. They may request Private deployment in eu-west later.
sarah-cs: we have standard SOC2 artifacts. I can push a refreshed security questionnaire and flag the potential VPC/private path to solutions engineering.
raj-dealdesk: please attach the exact ratecard numbers in the deal ticket. Also include a contingency clause: if usage exceeds 120% of commit for 2 consecutive months, auto-escalate to a premium rate or require top-up.
mike-deals: copying a short pricing snippet for deal desk review:
```
List monthly cost (per GPU-hr): $4.10
27k hrs x $4.10 = $110,700/mo (list)
25% off for 6mo -> $83,025/mo for months 1-6
10% off after -> $99,630/mo for months 7-12
```
raj-dealdesk: looks good. Requesting approval from finance for the temporary 25% promo. If finance signs off, deal desk will issue the exception and route to legal for SLA clause.
renewal-bot: Reminder: renewal playbook step 3 (deal desk approval) pending. Due in 72h.
jess-legal: I’ll draft the SLA addendum with remedies and the maintenance/force-majeure carveouts. Expect a PRR by EOD tomorrow.
mike-deals: thanks everyone. @sarah-cs can you start the security questionnaire refresh and share artifacts in the deal ticket? I’ll open the finance approval request once raj confirms.
sarah-cs: on it — will drop SOC2 report and data-flow diagram into the ticket by EOD.
raj-dealdesk: finance approved the temporary 25% for months 1-6 (email thread attached). Moving to prepare the exception doc and terms.
anna-sales: great — I’ll set up a call with OmniHealth for tomorrow to confirm they accept the commit and ramp plan. :thumbsup:
